meta_description:
56K likes, 853 comments - kubbrasait on April 8, 2025: "“Success is not about being the BEST, it’s about being better than YOU were yesterday.”
-Kubbra Sait

I get asked a lot, “Did you want to be an actor as a child?”
The answer is: no.

Yes, I was full-on drama — a nautanki, a joker, a jester — and I loved the attention. But did I dream of having or doing a job that’s creative, emotional, entertaining and bear the responsibility of being self-employed?
Absolutely not.

I did want to live in Mumbai though — and after a rollercoaster ride (or two), I made it to this city of dreams.

Back then, my only stage experience was in a school drama class. Cut to now: years of being an actor, learning on the job, set after set.
This post feels like a thank you note for the journey so far.

Thank you to my co-actors and directors and every writer who created parts I could sink my teeth into… and immerse a piece of my heart in.

Here’s to the stories we tell — and the stories still to come.

#Gratitude #ActorLife #MumbaiDreaming #OpenBook #KubbraSait #India #Love #Joy #showreel".
